name: comp-160
blurb: Radio cards with brand logos, one selected at a time.
description: Payment method selector using card-style radio buttons with embedded SVG logos and descriptions.
use_when: Choosing a payment method or any branded option where logo recognition helps customers identify choices.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or spaces where custom SVG rendering is unreliable.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with proper aria-describedby labels and focus management. SVG logos marked as aria-hidden.
